question.text: When a long glass capillary tube of radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>015</mn><mi>cm</mi></math> is dipped in a liquid, the liquid rises to a height of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>15</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> within it.
